speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. He gives the crown over. No one in the scene helps him, and no one stops him.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I don't— I don't say we can't. Show me where it's written that we can, this week.

speaker: james_burbage
text: They set a gallows at the Mayor's door on Friday, and you'd put a king down on my stage?

speaker: george_bryan
text: Send it to the Master whole, and let the cutting be his and not ours.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Whole, then. I will not have us mending a king in the tiring-house, with Friday still warm in the yard.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast read him as he is, Will. I would play him as he is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: As he is. The Master may cut what he will. We will not do his office for him because the week is frightened.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have had Tower Hill at one door and the Mayor at the next, all the way from the gate. I heard your last page from the passage. You might have waited the act.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The act would not wait. Sit, if the end is what you came for. The end is all that is left.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I'll hear the end. You might have kept a door in it for a man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hear it first, Will.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And where do I come in?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Late, Will. You've done it already.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Done, and I was on the stair, taking the news like a dutiful fellow. You owe me a door that opens while there is still play on the other side of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Another day. This room has spent what jest it had, and I am not sorry for the spending.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: You will live till the next comedy, Will. This king has no jig sewn on him, and I am not the man to sew one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The book is not a bill. Nothing of him goes up this week. We were already at no play before we sat, and the afternoon was struck before that.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Struck, and it stays struck. I will open my doors for a comedy the City cannot hang a riot on. I will not open them for a crown coming off.

speaker: george_bryan
text: So the Master has it whole. The fair copy is not this morning's labour, and nobody's man carries a book to Clerkenwell tonight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Not tonight. Every face that came up was looked at. Let the gate look at a house that stays quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Agreed. Whole to the Master. The cutting is his, when he comes to it. We do not play the king.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Home under my arm, then. They ride quieter than a yard would.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Take them, Dick. I am not calling them back tonight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I will have a play where a man may enter before the finish of it. You and I are not done, Will. We are only done for today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Home by the streets you came. No one stops a second time for the news. Once was the morning.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Once was enough. The page has been heard. The yard has not.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Out, then, the lot of you. My table is a table again. I want my ordinary dinner, and no crowns in it.
